remarks: Welcome to your oasis! This stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers a luxurious living experience in the city of Stamford! Completely Renovated! Step into a world of comfort and style as you explore the features of this exceptional residence. As you enter, you'll be greeted by a spacious living room bathed in natural light, perfect for entertaining guests or relaxing after a long day. The oversized balcony provides a private outdoor retreat, ideal for enjoying your morning coffee or evening sunsets in tranquility. The recently renovated kitchen boasts brand new appliances, making meal preparation a breeze. With ample counter space and storage, culinary adventures await you in this modern culinary haven. Both bedrooms feature walk-in closets, offering plenty of storage space for your wardrobe and belongings. The private master suite is a sanctuary unto itself, providing a peaceful haven for rest and relaxation. But the luxury doesn't end there! This condo is nestled within a prestigious building that offers a full suite of amenities to enhance your lifestyle. From the convenience of a doorman and mail service to the opportunity to stay fit in the well-equipped gym, every need is catered to with ease. And for those seeking a breath of fresh air, the private park provides a serene escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. With its coveted location, impeccable features, and unparalleled amenities, this unit won't last long!
